summary.text: Jennifer Massey is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Dana Trabulsy (R).
She works as an associate director and, in a Ballotpedia survey, described herself as a mother and community leader with more than 20 years of leadership and management experience.

paragraphs.text: Massey earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix in 2012, and her career experience includes working as an associate director.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her experience includes serving veterans and advocating for safer, stronger communities.
Massey listed affordability, healthcare and education as her three key campaign messages in the Ballotpedia survey.
She said she is passionate about expanding economic opportunity, affordable healthcare and public education, and that she supports policies such as the Live Local Act on housing affordability.
